👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston,
Mukesh Ambani aur Gautam Adani ke beech ek zabardast race shuru ho chuki hai! Interesting baat ye hai ki ab tak ye dono ek-dusre ke business se hamesha door hi rahe the. Ek taraf Adani apna empire infrastructure aur power sectors mein badhate rahe… Aur doosri taraf Ambani telecom, petrochemicals aur retail mein busy the.

Lekin ab — renewable energy ke maidan mein — dono ka seedha takraav shuru ho chuka hai! Aur ye kahaani shuru hoti hai Gujarat ke Kutch se!!! In dono business tycoons ne milkar, Kutch me lagbhag 10 LAKH ACRES ki zameen develop karne jaa rahe hain!! Ji haaan 10 lakh acres ki zameen yaani Singapore se 5 guna bada land parcel develop hone jaa raha hai!! Isme Mukesh Ambani ne 5.5 lakh acres aur Adani ne 4.6 lakh acres develop karne ka project uthaya hai!!

Lekin sawal ye hai... KYUN??? Aakhir Kutch jaise ek salt desert me aisa kya chupa hai ki Bharat ke 2 sabse bade billionaires is banjar zameen me interested hai? 10 lakh acres me akhir hone kya wala hai?? Aur is business strategy se hum kya seekh sakte hain??
